findings.title: 关闭Agent总控后自动链仍调用模型并写账
findings.evidence: Generation-end branch checks quiet/world subfeature flags but never global enabled. Mock host with enabled:false and full started→ended→rendered sequence produced llmCalls=1 and persistedWorld=true. UI line5957 promises关闭后不会运行回合也不会写入状态.
findings.risk: User cannot rely on master stop control; unexpected quota use and state mutation.
findings.recommendation: At the existing lifecycle owner gate both task start and late commit on the master enabled contract; invalidate in-flight work when switched off. Keep safe injection cleanup.
findings.verification: enabled=false must produce zero calls and no metadata writes; disabling during delayed LLM/MVU/DB operation must prevent late mutation; re-enable restores one listener/chain.

findings.title: 后台静默调用期间下一轮可能永久漏记
findings.behavior: New player/AI reply arrives while prior background request remains pending
findings.evidence: started/rendered/ended ignore while isQuietBusy. Prior continuation also invalidates when chat tail changes. Isolated host: append next user+reply before resolving prior world call → replyCount2, requests1, persistedWorld=false; no queued retry. Source comments lines301-302 acknowledge omission but no compensation exists.
findings.risk: Both old and new replies may remain unaccounted; world/self/memory state diverges from chat.
findings.recommendation: Maintain a bounded per-chat pending latest reply at the existing lifecycle owner, drain after background chain ends; use reply/version identity and explicit skipped reason. Do not silently drop overlapping normal generations.
findings.verification: Delay first bookkeeping, produce second normal reply, then release first: current reply must be processed exactly once, stale result discarded, no infinite quiet recursion; switch chat cancels old queue.

findings.title: 记忆决定没有等待纳戒记账完成
findings.behavior: afterWorld launches self and memory concurrently despite dependency comment
findings.evidence: self run assigned at342-356 then not awaited. memory launch at369 starts immediately. Mock world resolution started self and memory requests while self unresolved (3 total). Comment line366 and README132 promise later consumers see newly posted account.
findings.risk: Memory decision can observe state before self/MVU commit; chronological dependency is not enforced. Actual prompt/state impact requires each consumer contract audit.
findings.recommendation: State explicit dependency graph; await only true prerequisites, keep independent NPC work parallel. Do not add blanket global serialization.
findings.verification: Delayed self completion test should prove memory reads intended committed state and failed self produces explicit partial result rather than assumed success.

findings.title: 热重载清理与正式停用清理不一致

findings.risk: Development hot reload can leave old listeners/singletons and late callbacks; HMR applicability not proven for production deployment.
findings.recommendation: Have hot disposal reuse the existing symmetric cleanup contract; no production rewrite or new framework.
findings.verification: Fake HMR/load-dispose-load should show listener and singleton counts return to baseline; no stale request commit.
